nominal_env: fresh env built with DR disabled; friction/COM/encoder bias read back at runtime
unit: whole clip from first frame to last frame
denominator: planned_steps = clip frames (fixed; matches released benchmark steps==frames for completed clips)

extra_metrics.whole_body: mean tracked-body position error (m) over the 14 TRACKED_BODIES, world frame and root-relative
extra_metrics.aggregation: per clip: mean over alive steps and value at fixed times; alive-only means reported together with executed_steps to expose survival bias

supersedes_for_new_runs: cuboi-g1/fullclip-nominal-v1 (kept unchanged; used by tier A)
